note: Vectors for pleya_verify/runner/lib/src/focus_walk.dart. Coordinates are the root space every /v1/ui_tree bound is reported in (1920x1080 on Apple TV). See SPEC.md.

cases.name: right.nav.adjacent
cases.why: Two neighbours in the bar with nothing between them is the shape every healthy rightward hop has.

cases.name: right.nav.double-step
cases.why: One RIGHT that moves two positions is the NAV1 symptom, seen from the geometry side.

cases.name: right.nav.double-step.allowed
cases.why: `allow` is how a scenario says a candidate may be passed; it silences that candidate and nothing else.

cases.name: right.nav.allow-one-of-two
cases.why: Allowing one of two passed candidates still leaves the other as a finding.

cases.name: right.nav.wrap
cases.why: The bar deliberately does not wrap (hoofdstuk 7.2), so a landing back at the first item is a defect, not a style.

cases.name: right.nav.backwards
cases.why: A rightward press that lands to the left is the same defect without the wrap.

cases.name: right.overhang.inside-tolerance
cases.why: A candidate whose far edge stops just short of the landing is still between the two.

cases.name: right.overhang.past-tolerance
cases.why: A candidate reaching 16px past the landing's near edge sits beside it, not between; 8px of overhang is the line.

cases.name: right.out-of-band
cases.why: A node two rows down was never reachable in a straight line and is not an alternative.

cases.name: right.ancestor-scope
cases.why: A focus scope wrapping the whole bar contains both endpoints; counting it would make every hop red.

cases.name: right.zero-area
cases.why: A collapsed node has no area and cannot be focused into view.

cases.name: right.language-page.rows-share-x
cases.why: RIGHT on the language page lands on series row 0 while rows 1-5 sit under it; they share the landing's x-range, so none of them is between.

cases.name: right.expected-hop-still-checked
cases.why: `expect` waives the forwardness check, never the skip check.

cases.name: left.nav.adjacent
cases.why: The mirror of the healthy rightward hop.

cases.name: left.nav.series-to-search-over-home
cases.why: Series to Zoeken over Home: the exact double step the Apple TV reported (log y0w9x), in the direction it was reported in.

cases.name: left.nav.first-to-profile
cases.why: The first destination hands LEFT to the profile chip, which is the only thing to its left.

cases.name: left.nav.wrap
cases.why: Wrapping from the first item to the last is not a leftward step.

cases.name: left.allow
cases.why: Allowing the one candidate in between turns the hop green.

cases.name: left.out-of-band
cases.why: A node in another row is out of the source's band on the way left too.

cases.name: left.overhang.inside-tolerance
cases.why: Overhang is measured against the landing's near edge, which on a leftward hop is its right edge.

cases.name: left.overhang.past-tolerance
cases.why: Reaching 16px past the landing's right edge puts the candidate beside it.

cases.name: down.hero-to-first-tile
cases.why: The wide hero drops onto tile 1 while tile 3 is nearer its centre. The tiles share a top edge, so none of them is between the hero and the landing.

cases.name: down.rail1-to-rail2
cases.why: One row down, nothing in between.

cases.name: down.rail1-to-rail3
cases.why: A row that jumps over a whole rail is the finding this oracle exists for.

cases.name: down.rail1-to-rail3.allowed
cases.why: Allowing the intervening tile is how a scenario states a deliberate jump.

cases.name: down.nav-to-hero
cases.why: Leaving the bar for the page below it.

cases.name: down.backwards
cases.why: A downward press landing above the source.

cases.name: down.band-just-under-half
cases.why: Just under half the band shared with the source: not reachable in a straight line.

cases.name: down.band-exactly-half
cases.why: Exactly half is enough — the boundary is inclusive, and stating it here keeps it from drifting.

cases.name: down.centre-on-source-edge
cases.why: A candidate whose centre lands exactly on the source's far edge is not yet ahead of it.

cases.name: down.centre-just-past-source-edge
cases.why: One pixel past that edge and the candidate counts — the two vectors together pin the boundary.

cases.name: down.offscreen-candidate
cases.why: The row below the fold is not a choice a viewer can make, even though it lies between the source and a landing that is itself offscreen in this frame.

cases.name: down.expected-waives-forwardness
cases.why: A hop a scenario named in `expect` may land somewhere the geometry calls backwards — a remembered tile, a re-entry — and only the forwardness check is waived.

cases.name: up.rail2-to-rail1
cases.why: The mirror of one row down.

cases.name: up.rail3-to-rail1
cases.why: Jumping a rail upward is the same finding as jumping one downward.

cases.name: up.rail1-to-hero
cases.why: Leaving the first rail for the hero above it.

cases.name: up.backwards
cases.why: An upward press landing below the source.

cases.name: up.allow
cases.why: Allowing the rail in between.

cases.name: up.out-of-band
cases.why: A tile three columns over shares no band with the source.

cases.name: inconclusive.landing-not-in-pre-frame
cases.why: A landing the scroll built cannot be judged against the frame the press was issued in; one such hop is a note, a walk made only of them is red.

cases.name: identity.same-rect-different-node
cases.why: Two nodes can share a rect (a wrapper and its child); the node number is what tells the source apart from a candidate sitting on top of it.
